title: An agent can see which source observation made an evaluation stale or refused it
outcome: An agent can see which source observation made an evaluation stale or refused it
acceptance: Tests cover a sighting at an undeclared revision with source_changed false, a change to the declared revision in the declared workspace (exempt, so not named as a cause), and a sighting on another workspace (not named under a named root)

When an evaluation is refused, or reads stale, because a source observation after its cut decided that the source moved, the refusal and show name that observation: its run-feed position, workspace, revision, reporting session and time, each as recorded, beside the revision the evaluation declared or, without one, the revision judged at its cut; a refusal or staleness with another cause names no observation

show can list the source observations of the item's active or latest run, those on other workspaces included (position, workspace, revision, source_changed, reporting session, time), within its usual window and byte budget, as a read that records nothing

completion.summary: When an evaluation is refused as void, or reads stale, because a source observation after its cut decided that the source moved, the refusal and show name that observation (run-feed position, workspace, revision, reporting session, times, beside the declared or cut-judged revision). Causes and words unchanged; the refusal adds one bounded, one-line sentence that never spells "database is locked" (also not after whitespace collapsing, and not in the CLI JSON stderr, whose fields decode unchanged) and details.deciding_observation; plain and full show, the evaluations window and record detail add a line and stale_observation (fields cut at 128 bytes). show --observations lists the active or latest run's source observations, other workspaces included, in a bounded read-only window. Landed as 9da39db after three rounds (last: gate test-d8c80100 passed; Codex and Claude no Medium); installed build 79e14691; independent evaluation ef585255 passed all three criteria.
